end.parentNote: Navya practised listening to a story and retelling what happened in order. Using the cap-trick clue helped them correct the toy-seller mix-up and explain why the monkeys returned the caps. At home, ask one simple who, what, or where question after a short story and let Navya answer in a full sentence.
